{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMqgUkTA9gC5NAExoo6H","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-DateType.md ===\n# FEATURE: Date Type Inference\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261024 V1 |\n| Description | Infer the date column type from YYYY-MM-DD values that are real calendar dates. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-NumericTypes.md |\n| Provides    | InferType date |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nAfter integer and number have been ruled out for a column, the column is `date` when every non-null\nvalue matches `YYYY-MM-DD` and names a real calendar date. A value such as `2025-02-30` has the right\nshape but is not a calendar date, so it fails the date test and the column falls through to the next\ncandidate type (`boolean`, then `text`).\n\n## Trigger\n\nType inference runs once per column after the file has been read, trimmed, and nulls classified.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Take the trimmed non-null values of the column.\n2. If every value is an integer, or every value is a number, the earlier types win (FEATURE-NumericTypes.md).\n3. Otherwise test each value: exactly four digits, a hyphen, two digits, a hyphen, two digits.\n4. Validate the year, month, and day as a real calendar date, with leap years honored\n   (`2024-02-29` is valid, `2025-02-29` is not). `time.Parse` with layout `2006-01-02` plus the\n   strict shape check is sufficient.\n5. The column is `date` only when every non-null value passes. Otherwise inference continues.\n\n## Reads\n\n- Trimmed non-null values of one column.\n\n## Writes\n\n- The inferred type token `date` for the column. Nothing is persisted.\n\n## Acceptance Notes\n\n- Single-digit month or day (`2025-2-3`) is not the `YYYY-MM-DD` shape and is not a date.\n- Month 00 or 13 and day 00 are not dates.\n- Null values never disqualify a date column.\n- A column that mixes dates and other values is not a date column.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC date-type-valid-column ===\nIntent: A column of valid YYYY-MM-DD values, including a leap day, is typed as date.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nvalues = [\"2024-02-29\", \"2025-12-31\", \"2015-08-27\"]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"d\"]] + [[str(i), v] for i, v in enumerate(values)]\nresult = profile(rows)\nassert result[0][0] == \"column\"\nby_name = {r[0]: r for r in result[1:]}\nassert by_name[\"d\"][1] == \"date\"\n=== END AC date-type-valid-column ===\n\n=== AC date-type-invalid-calendar-falls-to-text ===\nIntent: A value with the date shape that is not a real calendar date makes the column text.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nbad_values = [\"2025-02-30\", \"2025-02-29\", \"2025-13-01\", \"2025-00-10\", \"2025-04-31\"]\nfor bad in bad_values:\n    rows = [[\"id\", \"d\"], [\"1\", \"2025-01-15\"], [\"2\", bad]]\n    result = profile(rows)\n    by_name = {r[0]: r for r in result[1:]}\n    assert by_name[\"d\"][1] == \"text\", (bad, by_name[\"d\"])\n=== END AC date-type-invalid-calendar-falls-to-text ===\n\n=== AC date-type-wrong-shape ===\nIntent: Values that are not zero-padded YYYY-MM-DD are not dates.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nfor odd in [\"2025-2-3\", \"2025/02/03\", \"20250203\", \"2025-02-03T08:00\"]:\n    rows = [[\"id\", \"d\"], [\"1\", \"2025-01-15\"], [\"2\", odd]]\n    result = profile(rows)\n    by_name = {r[0]: r for r in result[1:]}\n    assert by_name[\"d\"][1] == \"text\", (odd, by_name[\"d\"])\n=== END AC date-type-wrong-shape ===\n\n=== AC date-type-nulls-ignored ===\nIntent: Null values and padded dates do not prevent a date column from being typed as date.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nrows = [\n    [\"id\", \"d\"],\n    [\"1\", \"2025-03-01\"],\n    [\"2\", \"\"],\n    [\"3\", \"NA\"],\n    [\"4\", \"n/a\"],\n    [\"5\", \"null\"],\n    [\"6\", \"  2025-03-02  \"],\n]\nresult = profile(rows)\nby_name = {r[0]: r for r in result[1:]}\nassert by_name[\"d\"][1] == \"date\", by_name[\"d\"]\n=== END AC date-type-nulls-ignored ===\n\n=== AC date-type-integer-wins-over-date ===\nIntent: A column of digits only keeps its integer type; the date test is applied after the numeric tests.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nrows = [[\"id\", \"n\", \"d\"], [\"1\", \"20250101\", \"2025-01-01\"], [\"2\", \"20250102\", \"2025-01-02\"]]\nresult = profile(rows)\nby_name = {r[0]: r for r in result[1:]}\nassert by_name[\"n\"][1] == \"integer\", by_name[\"n\"]\nassert by_name[\"d\"][1] == \"date\", by_name[\"d\"]\n=== END AC date-type-integer-wins-over-date ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Calendar validity is decided by the file's values only; no date, type, or value list is hardcoded.\n- Only the standard library is used for date validation.\n- Date columns keep their original text in `min` and `max`; no reformatting of dates occurs.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-BooleanTextTypes.md ===\n# FEATURE: Boolean, Text, and Empty Type Inference\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261024 V1 |\n| Description | Infer the boolean, text, and empty column types as the last steps of type inference. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-DateType.md |\n| Provides    | InferType boolean, InferType text, InferType empty |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nComplete the type inference order `integer`, `number`, `date`, `boolean`, `text`, plus the special\n`empty` type. A column is `boolean` when every non-null value equals `true` or `false` ignoring case.\nAny column that satisfies no earlier type is `text`. A column with no non-null values at all is `empty`.\n\n## Trigger\n\nType inference runs once per column after reading, trimming, and null classification.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. If the column has zero non-null values, its type is `empty`, and the `min`, `max`, `sum`, `mean`,\n   and `median` fields are written empty.\n2. Otherwise apply `integer`, `number`, `date` in order (earlier features).\n3. If every non-null value, compared case-insensitively, is `true` or `false`, the type is `boolean`.\n4. Otherwise the type is `text`.\n\n## Reads\n\n- Trimmed non-null values of one column.\n\n## Writes\n\n- The inferred type token for the column (`boolean`, `text`, or `empty`). Nothing is persisted.\n\n## Acceptance Notes\n\n- `1` and `0` are integers, never booleans.\n- `yes` and `no` are text.\n- A value consisting only of spaces is trimmed to empty and is null.\n- A file with a header and no rows gives every column the type `empty` with zero counts.\n- Every `empty` column writes empty `min`, `max`, `sum`, `mean`, and `median`.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC boolean-type-case-insensitive ===\nIntent: A column of true and false in any letter case is typed as boolean.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nvalues = [\"true\", \"FALSE\", \"True\", \"false\", \"TRUE\", \"False\"]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"b\"]] + [[str(i), v] for i, v in enumerate(values)]\nresult = profile(rows)\nby_name = {r[0]: r for r in result[1:]}\nassert by_name[\"b\"][1] == \"boolean\", by_name[\"b\"]\n=== END AC boolean-type-case-insensitive ===\n\n=== AC boolean-type-needs-every-value ===\nIntent: One non-boolean value makes a column text, and 1/0 or yes/no columns are not boolean.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nmixed = [\"true\", \"false\", \"maybe\"]\nyesno = [\"yes\", \"no\", \"yes\"]\nbits = [\"1\", \"0\", \"1\"]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"mixed\", \"yesno\", \"bits\"]]\nfor i in range(3):\n    rows.append([str(i), mixed[i], yesno[i], bits[i]])\nresult = profile(rows)\nby_name = {r[0]: r for r in result[1:]}\nassert by_name[\"mixed\"][1] == \"text\", by_name[\"mixed\"]\nassert by_name[\"yesno\"][1] == \"text\", by_name[\"yesno\"]\nassert by_name[\"bits\"][1] == \"integer\", by_name[\"bits\"]\n=== END AC boolean-type-needs-every-value ===\n\n=== AC boolean-type-nulls-ignored ===\nIntent: Null spellings do not disqualify a boolean column.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nvalues = [\"true\", \"\", \"NA\", \"N/A\", \"NULL\", \"false\", \"  \"]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"b\"]] + [[str(i), v] for i, v in enumerate(values)]\nresult = profile(rows)\nby_name = {r[0]: r for r in result[1:]}\nassert by_name[\"b\"][1] == \"boolean\", by_name[\"b\"]\n=== END AC boolean-type-nulls-ignored ===\n\n=== AC text-type-fallback ===\nIntent: A column of arbitrary words, and one holding an invalid date beside valid dates, is typed as text.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nwords = [\"alpha\", \"beta\", \"relocating to Austin, TX\"]\ndates = [\"2025-03-01\", \"2025-02-30\", \"2025-03-02\"]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"w\", \"d\"]]\nfor i in range(3):\n    rows.append([str(i), words[i], dates[i]])\nresult = profile(rows)\nby_name = {r[0]: r for r in result[1:]}\nassert by_name[\"w\"][1] == \"text\", by_name[\"w\"]\nassert by_name[\"d\"][1] == \"text\", by_name[\"d\"]\n=== END AC text-type-fallback ===\n\n=== AC empty-type-all-null-column ===\nIntent: A column whose every value is null is typed empty and its statistic fields are written empty.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nnulls = [\"\", \"NA\", \"null\", \" \", \"N/A\", \"NULL\"]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"e\"]] + [[str(i), v] for i, v in enumerate(nulls)]\nresult = profile(rows)\nheader = result[0]\nby_name = {r[0]: dict(zip(header, r)) for r in result[1:]}\ne = by_name[\"e\"]\nassert e[\"type\"] == \"empty\", e\nassert e[\"rows\"] == str(len(nulls)), e\nassert e[\"nulls\"] == str(len(nulls)), e\nassert e[\"distinct\"] == str(0), e\nfor field in [\"min\", \"max\", \"sum\", \"mean\", \"median\"]:\n    assert e[field] == \"\", (field, e)\n=== END AC empty-type-all-null-column ===\n\n=== AC empty-type-header-only-file ===\nIntent: A file with a header and no data rows types every column empty with zero counts.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nnames = [\"sku\", \"price\", \"in_stock\"]\nresult = profile([names])\nheader = result[0]\nassert len(result) == 1 + len(names), result\nfor name, row in zip(names, result[1:]):\n    rec = dict(zip(header, row))\n    assert rec[\"column\"] == name, rec\n    assert rec[\"type\"] == \"empty\", rec\n    assert rec[\"rows\"] == str(0), rec\n    assert rec[\"nulls\"] == str(0), rec\n    assert rec[\"distinct\"] == str(0), rec\n=== END AC empty-type-header-only-file ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- No column type is hardcoded; every type comes from the values of the file examined.\n- `empty` is assigned only when there are no non-null values; it is never assigned to a column that has any non-null value.\n- Standard library only.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-Counts.md ===\n# FEATURE: Row, Null, and Distinct Counts\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261024 V1 |\n| Description | Report the rows, nulls, and distinct count of every column. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-BooleanTextTypes.md |\n| Provides    | stats rows, stats nulls, stats distinct |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nFor every column the profile reports three counts: `rows` (data records), `nulls` (null values), and\n`distinct` (different non-null values). They are computed from the trimmed values of the column.\n\n## Trigger\n\nComputed once per column when the profile is built.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. `rows` is the number of data records, excluding the header. It is the same for every column.\n2. `nulls` counts values that are empty or equal `NA`, `N/A`, or `NULL` ignoring case after trimming.\n3. `distinct` counts the different non-null values, compared as exact strings after trimming. Case\n   differs, so `Acme` and `acme` are two values. `Globex` and `  Globex  ` are one value.\n\n## Reads\n\n- Trimmed values of one column.\n\n## Writes\n\n- Three integer fields written as plain decimal integers.\n\n## Acceptance Notes\n\n- A header-only file gives `rows`, `nulls`, and `distinct` of zero for every column.\n- A null never contributes to `distinct`.\n- A quoted field containing a comma is one value.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC counts-rows-nulls-distinct ===\nIntent: rows, nulls, and distinct match counts derived from the values the criterion wrote.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef is_null(v):\n    t = v.strip()\n    return t == \"\" or t.upper() in {\"NA\", \"N/A\", \"NULL\"}\n\n\nvalues = [\"red\", \"blue\", \"red\", \"\", \"NA\", \"blue\", \"green\", \"n/a\", \"NULL\", \"red\"]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"c\"]] + [[str(i), v] for i, v in enumerate(values)]\nresult = profile(rows)\nheader = result[0]\nby_name = {r[0]: dict(zip(header, r)) for r in result[1:]}\nc = by_name[\"c\"]\nnon_null = [v.strip() for v in values if not is_null(v)]\nassert c[\"rows\"] == str(len(values)), c\nassert c[\"nulls\"] == str(len(values) - len(non_null)), c\nassert c[\"distinct\"] == str(len(set(non_null))), c\nassert by_name[\"id\"][\"rows\"] == c[\"rows\"], by_name\n=== END AC counts-rows-nulls-distinct ===\n\n=== AC counts-distinct-trims-and-is-case-sensitive ===\nIntent: Padding does not create a new distinct value, while a case difference does.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nvalues = [\"Globex\", \"  Globex  \", \"Globex \", \"globex\", \"Acme Corp \", \"Acme Corp\"]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"c\"]] + [[str(i), v] for i, v in enumerate(values)]\nresult = profile(rows)\nheader = result[0]\nc = {r[0]: dict(zip(header, r)) for r in result[1:]}[\"c\"]\nexpected = len({v.strip() for v in values})\nassert c[\"distinct\"] == str(expected), c\nassert c[\"nulls\"] == str(0), c\n=== END AC counts-distinct-trims-and-is-case-sensitive ===\n\n=== AC counts-quoted-comma-is-one-value ===\nIntent: A quoted field containing a comma is counted as a single value.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydict_placeholder import nothing  # noqa\n=== END AC counts-quoted-comma-is-one-value ===\n\n=== AC counts-header-only ===\nIntent: A file with only a header reports zero rows, nulls, and distinct for each column.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nnames = [\"a\", \"b\", \"c\"]\nresult = profile([names])\nheader = result[0]\nassert len(result) == 1 + len(names), result\nfor row in result[1:]:\n    rec = dict(zip(header, row))\n    for field in [\"rows\", \"nulls\", \"distinct\"]:\n        assert rec[field] == str(0), rec\n=== END AC counts-header-only ===\n\n=== AC counts-single-column-selection ===\nIntent: The counts reported for one column through --column equal those in the full profile.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef run(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nvalues = [\"x\", \"y\", \"\", \"x\", \"NA\"]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"c\"]] + [[str(i), v] for i, v in enumerate(values)]\nfull = run(rows)\none = run(rows, \"--column\", \"c\")\nheader = full[0]\nassert one[0] == header, (one[0], header)\nassert len(one) == 2, one\nfull_c = [r for r in full[1:] if r[0] == \"c\"][0]\nfor field in [\"rows\", \"nulls\", \"distinct\"]:\n    idx = header.index(field)\n    assert one[1][idx] == full_c[idx], field\n=== END AC counts-single-column-selection ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Counts are computed from the file examined; none is hardcoded.\n- Distinct is a comparison of exact trimmed strings, never case-folded or numerically normalized.\n- Counts are written as plain integers.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-DecimalFormat.md ===\n# FEATURE: Decimal Formatting\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261024 V1 |\n| Description | Format exact decimal statistics with two places, rounded once half away from zero. |\n| Depends On  | ARCHITECTURE.md |\n| Provides    | FormatDecimal |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nEvery `number` column `min`, `max`, and `sum`, and every `mean` and `median` of an integer or number\ncolumn, is written with exactly two decimal places. The value is held exactly as a `math/big` rational\nand rounded once at output, half away from zero. Integer `min`, `max`, and `sum` are written as plain\nintegers.\n\n## Trigger\n\nCalled whenever a profile field holds a decimal value.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Take the exact value as a `*big.Rat`.\n2. Multiply by 100, then round to an integer with ties going away from zero (for example `0.005`\n   becomes `0.01` and `-0.005` becomes `-0.01`).\n3. Write the integer part, a decimal point, and exactly two fraction digits. No thousands separator.\n4. Write a leading `-` only when the rounded result is non-zero and negative. A value that rounds to\n   zero is written `0.00` with no sign (decision Q-002).\n\n## Reads\n\n- An exact rational value.\n\n## Writes\n\n- A string of the form `-?[0-9]+\\.[0-9]{2}`.\n\n## Acceptance Notes\n\n- Rounding happens once, on the exact value, never on an already rounded intermediate and never through\n  `float64`.\n- `1012.50`, `-12.21`, and `0.00` are well formed outputs.\n- The mean of `0.01` and `0.02` is exactly `0.015` and is written `0.02`.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC decimal-single-value-rounding ===\nIntent: A one-value number column writes min, max, sum, mean, and median as the value rounded half away from zero to two places.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef two_places(d):\n    q = d.quantize(Decimal(\"0.01\"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)\n    if q == 0:\n        q = abs(q)\n    return format(q, \"f\")\n\n\ninputs = [\"0.005\", \"-0.005\", \"2.675\", \"-2.675\", \"1.005\", \"1012.5\", \"123456789.125\", \"0.001\", \"-0.001\", \"0.00\"]\nfor text in inputs:\n    result = profile([[\"id\", \"v\"], [\"1\", text]])\n    header = result[0]\n    rec = {r[0]: dict(zip(header, r)) for r in result[1:]}[\"v\"]\n    expected = two_places(Decimal(text))\n    assert rec[\"type\"] == \"number\", (text, rec)\n    for field in [\"min\", \"max\", \"sum\", \"mean\", \"median\"]:\n        assert rec[field] == expected, (text, field, rec)\n=== END AC decimal-single-value-rounding ===\n\n=== AC decimal-mean-is-exact ===\nIntent: The mean is computed exactly and rounded once, so a tie in the exact mean rounds away from zero.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP, getcontext\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ngetcontext().prec = 50\n\n\ndef two_places(d):\n    q = d.quantize(Decimal(\"0.01\"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)\n    if q == 0:\n        q = abs(q)\n    return format(q, \"f\")\n\n\nfor pair in [(\"0.01\", \"0.02\"), (\"-0.01\", \"-0.02\"), (\"1.10\", \"2.25\"), (\"0.10\", \"0.15\")]:\n    result = profile([[\"id\", \"v\"], [\"1\", pair[0]], [\"2\", pair[1]]])\n    header = result[0]\n    rec = {r[0]: dict(zip(header, r)) for r in result[1:]}[\"v\"]\n    values = [Decimal(p) for p in pair]\n    mean = sum(values) / len(values)\n    assert rec[\"mean\"] == two_places(mean), (pair, rec)\n    assert rec[\"median\"] == two_places(mean), (pair, rec)\n    assert rec[\"sum\"] == two_places(sum(values)), (pair, rec)\n=== END AC decimal-mean-is-exact ===\n\n=== AC decimal-no-negative-zero ===\nIntent: A negative value that rounds to zero is written without a minus sign.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nresult = profile([[\"id\", \"v\"], [\"1\", \"-0.001\"], [\"2\", \"-0.002\"]])\nheader = result[0]\nrec = {r[0]: dict(zip(header, r)) for r in result[1:]}[\"v\"]\nfor field in [\"min\", \"max\", \"sum\", \"mean\", \"median\"]:\n    assert not rec[field].startswith(\"-\"), (field, rec)\n    assert float(rec[field]) == 0.0, (field, rec)\n=== END AC decimal-no-negative-zero ===\n\n=== AC decimal-integer-columns-plain-and-mean-two-places ===\nIntent: Integer min, max, and sum are plain integers while integer mean and median use two decimal places.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nvalues = [1, 2, 10]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"v\"]] + [[str(i), str(v)] for i, v in enumerate(values)]\nresult = profile(rows)\nheader = result[0]\nrec = {r[0]: dict(zip(header, r)) for r in result[1:]}[\"v\"]\nassert rec[\"type\"] == \"integer\", rec\nassert rec[\"min\"] == str(min(values)), rec\nassert rec[\"max\"] == str(max(values)), rec\nassert rec[\"sum\"] == str(sum(values)), rec\nassert rec[\"mean\"] == format(sum(values) / len(values), \".2f\"), rec\nassert rec[\"median\"] == format(2, \".2f\"), rec\n=== END AC decimal-integer-columns-plain-and-mean-two-places ===\n\n=== AC decimal-no-thousands-separator ===\nIntent: Large decimal totals are written without a thousands separator and unquoted.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return out, list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nvalues = [\"1000000.50\", \"2000000.25\", \"3000000.75\"]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"v\"]] + [[str(i), v] for i, v in enumerate(values)]\nraw, result = profile(rows)\nheader = result[0]\nrec = {r[0]: dict(zip(header, r)) for r in result[1:]}[\"v\"]\ntotal = sum(Decimal(v) for v in values)\nassert rec[\"sum\"] == format(total, \".2f\"), rec\nassert \",\" not in rec[\"sum\"], rec\n=== END AC decimal-no-thousands-separator ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Never use `float64` to compute or round a statistic; use `math/big`.\n- Round exactly once, half away from zero, at the moment of writing.\n- No thousands separator and no locale-dependent formatting.\n- A result that rounds to zero carries no minus sign.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-MinMax.md ===\n# FEATURE: Minimum and Maximum\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261024 V1 |\n| Description | Report the min and max of every column according to the ordering rule of its type. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-Counts.md, FEATURE-DecimalFormat.md |\n| Provides    | stats min, stats max |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nEach column row carries a `min` and a `max` computed over its non-null values, using the ordering\nrule of the column's inferred type.\n\n## Trigger\n\nComputed once per column when the profile is built.\n\n## Sequence\n\n| Type | Rule |\n|---|---|\n| `integer` | Numerically smallest and largest, written as plain integers. |\n| `number` | Numerically smallest and largest, written with two decimals (FEATURE-DecimalFormat.md). |\n| `date` | Earliest and latest date, written as in the file. |\n| `boolean` | `min` is `false` if any value is false, else `true`; `max` is `true` if any value is true, else `false`. Written in lower case. |\n| `text` | Smallest and largest by byte value of the trimmed string. |\n| `empty` | Both fields empty. |\n\n## Reads\n\n- Trimmed non-null values of one column and its inferred type.\n\n## Writes\n\n- The `min` and `max` fields of the profile row.\n\n## Acceptance Notes\n\n- Integer ordering is numeric: `9` is less than `10`, and `-3` is less than both.\n- Text ordering is by bytes, so upper case letters sort before lower case letters, and `10` sorts before `9`.\n- Nulls never take part.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC minmax-integer-numeric-order ===\nIntent: Integer min and max are numeric, include negatives, and ignore nulls.\nRequires: executable=go; BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-DateType.md ===\n# FEATURE: Date Type Inference\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261024 V1 |\n| Description | Infer the date column type from YYYY-MM-DD values that are real calendar dates. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-NumericTypes.md |\n| Provides    | InferType date |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nAfter integer and number have been ruled out for a column, the column is `date` when every non-null\nvalue matches `YYYY-MM-DD` and names a real calendar date. A value such as `2025-02-30` has the right\nshape but is not a calendar date, so it fails the date test and the column falls through to the next\ncandidate type (`boolean`, then `text`).\n\n## Trigger\n\nType inference runs once per column after the file has been read, trimmed, and nulls classified.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Take the trimmed non-null values of the column.\n2. If every value is an integer, or every value is a number, the earlier types win (FEATURE-NumericTypes.md).\n3. Otherwise test each value: exactly four digits, a hyphen, two digits, a hyphen, two digits.\n4. Validate the year, month, and day as a real calendar date, with leap years honored\n   (`2024-02-29` is valid, `2025-02-29` is not). `time.Parse` with layout `2006-01-02` plus the\n   strict shape check is sufficient.\n5. The column is `date` only when every non-null value passes. Otherwise inference continues.\n\n## Reads\n\n- Trimmed non-null values of one column.\n\n## Writes\n\n- The inferred type token `date` for the column. Nothing is persisted.\n\n## Acceptance Notes\n\n- Single-digit month or day (`2025-2-3`) is not the `YYYY-MM-DD` shape and is not a date.\n- Month 00 or 13 and day 00 are not dates.\n- Null values never disqualify a date column.\n- A column that mixes dates and other values is not a date column.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC date-type-valid-column ===\nIntent: A column of valid YYYY-MM-DD values, including a leap day, is typed as date.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nvalues = [\"2024-02-29\", \"2025-12-31\", \"2015-08-27\"]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"d\"]] + [[str(i), v] for i, v in enumerate(values)]\nresult = profile(rows)\nassert result[0][0] == \"column\"\nby_name = {r[0]: r for r in result[1:]}\nassert by_name[\"d\"][1] == \"date\"\n=== END AC date-type-valid-column ===\n\n=== AC date-type-invalid-calendar-falls-to-text ===\nIntent: A value with the date shape that is not a real calendar date makes the column text.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nbad_values = [\"2025-02-30\", \"2025-02-29\", \"2025-13-01\", \"2025-00-10\", \"2025-04-31\"]\nfor bad in bad_values:\n    rows = [[\"id\", \"d\"], [\"1\", \"2025-01-15\"], [\"2\", bad]]\n    result = profile(rows)\n    by_name = {r[0]: r for r in result[1:]}\n    assert by_name[\"d\"][1] == \"text\", (bad, by_name[\"d\"])\n=== END AC date-type-invalid-calendar-falls-to-text ===\n\n=== AC date-type-wrong-shape ===\nIntent: Values that are not zero-padded YYYY-MM-DD are not dates.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nfor odd in [\"2025-2-3\", \"2025/02/03\", \"20250203\", \"2025-02-03T08:00\"]:\n    rows = [[\"id\", \"d\"], [\"1\", \"2025-01-15\"], [\"2\", odd]]\n    result = profile(rows)\n    by_name = {r[0]: r for r in result[1:]}\n    assert by_name[\"d\"][1] == \"text\", (odd, by_name[\"d\"])\n=== END AC date-type-wrong-shape ===\n\n=== AC date-type-nulls-ignored ===\nIntent: Null values and padded dates do not prevent a date column from being typed as date.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nrows = [\n    [\"id\", \"d\"],\n    [\"1\", \"2025-03-01\"],\n    [\"2\", \"\"],\n    [\"3\", \"NA\"],\n    [\"4\", \"n/a\"],\n    [\"5\", \"null\"],\n    [\"6\", \"  2025-03-02  \"],\n]\nresult = profile(rows)\nby_name = {r[0]: r for r in result[1:]}\nassert by_name[\"d\"][1] == \"date\", by_name[\"d\"]\n=== END AC date-type-nulls-ignored ===\n\n=== AC date-type-integer-wins-over-date ===\nIntent: A column of digits only keeps its integer type; the date test is applied after the numeric tests.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nrows = [[\"id\", \"n\", \"d\"], [\"1\", \"20250101\", \"2025-01-01\"], [\"2\", \"20250102\", \"2025-01-02\"]]\nresult = profile(rows)\nby_name = {r[0]: r for r in result[1:]}\nassert by_name[\"n\"][1] == \"integer\", by_name[\"n\"]\nassert by_name[\"d\"][1] == \"date\", by_name[\"d\"]\n=== END AC date-type-integer-wins-over-date ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Calendar validity is decided by the file's values only; no date, type, or value list is hardcoded.\n- Only the standard library is used for date validation.\n- Date columns keep their original text in `min` and `max`; no reformatting of dates occurs.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-BooleanTextTypes.md ===\n# FEATURE: Boolean, Text, and Empty Type Inference\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261024 V1 |\n| Description | Infer the boolean, text, and empty column types as the last steps of type inference. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-DateType.md |\n| Provides    | InferType boolean, InferType text, InferType empty |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nComplete the type inference order `integer`, `number`, `date`, `boolean`, `text`, plus the special\n`empty` type. A column is `boolean` when every non-null value equals `true` or `false` ignoring case.\nAny column that satisfies no earlier type is `text`. A column with no non-null values at all is `empty`.\n\n## Trigger\n\nType inference runs once per column after reading, trimming, and null classification.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. If the column has zero non-null values, its type is `empty`, and the `min`, `max`, `sum`, `mean`,\n   and `median` fields are written empty.\n2. Otherwise apply `integer`, `number`, `date` in order (earlier features).\n3. If every non-null value, compared case-insensitively, is `true` or `false`, the type is `boolean`.\n4. Otherwise the type is `text`.\n\n## Reads\n\n- Trimmed non-null values of one column.\n\n## Writes\n\n- The inferred type token for the column (`boolean`, `text`, or `empty`). Nothing is persisted.\n\n## Acceptance Notes\n\n- `1` and `0` are integers, never booleans.\n- `yes` and `no` are text.\n- A value consisting only of spaces is trimmed to empty and is null.\n- A file with a header and no rows gives every column the type `empty` with zero counts.\n- Every `empty` column writes empty `min`, `max`, `sum`, `mean`, and `median`.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC boolean-type-case-insensitive ===\nIntent: A column of true and false in any letter case is typed as boolean.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nvalues = [\"true\", \"FALSE\", \"True\", \"false\", \"TRUE\", \"False\"]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"b\"]] + [[str(i), v] for i, v in enumerate(values)]\nresult = profile(rows)\nby_name = {r[0]: r for r in result[1:]}\nassert by_name[\"b\"][1] == \"boolean\", by_name[\"b\"]\n=== END AC boolean-type-case-insensitive ===\n\n=== AC boolean-type-needs-every-value ===\nIntent: One non-boolean value makes a column text, and 1/0 or yes/no columns are not boolean.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nmixed = [\"true\", \"false\", \"maybe\"]\nyesno = [\"yes\", \"no\", \"yes\"]\nbits = [\"1\", \"0\", \"1\"]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"mixed\", \"yesno\", \"bits\"]]\nfor i in range(3):\n    rows.append([str(i), mixed[i], yesno[i], bits[i]])\nresult = profile(rows)\nby_name = {r[0]: r for r in result[1:]}\nassert by_name[\"mixed\"][1] == \"text\", by_name[\"mixed\"]\nassert by_name[\"yesno\"][1] == \"text\", by_name[\"yesno\"]\nassert by_name[\"bits\"][1] == \"integer\", by_name[\"bits\"]\n=== END AC boolean-type-needs-every-value ===\n\n=== AC boolean-type-nulls-ignored ===\nIntent: Null spellings do not disqualify a boolean column.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nvalues = [\"true\", \"\", \"NA\", \"N/A\", \"NULL\", \"false\", \"  \"]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"b\"]] + [[str(i), v] for i, v in enumerate(values)]\nresult = profile(rows)\nby_name = {r[0]: r for r in result[1:]}\nassert by_name[\"b\"][1] == \"boolean\", by_name[\"b\"]\n=== END AC boolean-type-nulls-ignored ===\n\n=== AC text-type-fallback ===\nIntent: A column of arbitrary words, and one holding an invalid date beside valid dates, is typed as text.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nwords = [\"alpha\", \"beta\", \"relocating to Austin, TX\"]\ndates = [\"2025-03-01\", \"2025-02-30\", \"2025-03-02\"]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"w\", \"d\"]]\nfor i in range(3):\n    rows.append([str(i), words[i], dates[i]])\nresult = profile(rows)\nby_name = {r[0]: r for r in result[1:]}\nassert by_name[\"w\"][1] == \"text\", by_name[\"w\"]\nassert by_name[\"d\"][1] == \"text\", by_name[\"d\"]\n=== END AC text-type-fallback ===\n\n=== AC empty-type-all-null-column ===\nIntent: A column whose every value is null is typed empty and its statistic fields are written empty.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nnulls = [\"\", \"NA\", \"null\", \" \", \"N/A\", \"NULL\"]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"e\"]] + [[str(i), v] for i, v in enumerate(nulls)]\nresult = profile(rows)\nheader = result[0]\nby_name = {r[0]: dict(zip(header, r)) for r in result[1:]}\ne = by_name[\"e\"]\nassert e[\"type\"] == \"empty\", e\nassert e[\"rows\"] == str(len(nulls)), e\nassert e[\"nulls\"] == str(len(nulls)), e\nassert e[\"distinct\"] == str(0), e\nfor field in [\"min\", \"max\", \"sum\", \"mean\", \"median\"]:\n    assert e[field] == \"\", (field, e)\n=== END AC empty-type-all-null-column ===\n\n=== AC empty-type-header-only-file ===\nIntent: A file with a header and no data rows types every column empty with zero counts.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nnames = [\"sku\", \"price\", \"in_stock\"]\nresult = profile([names])\nheader = result[0]\nassert len(result) == 1 + len(names), result\nfor name, row in zip(names, result[1:]):\n    rec = dict(zip(header, row))\n    assert rec[\"column\"] == name, rec\n    assert rec[\"type\"] == \"empty\", rec\n    assert rec[\"rows\"] == str(0), rec\n    assert rec[\"nulls\"] == str(0), rec\n    assert rec[\"distinct\"] == str(0), rec\n=== END AC empty-type-header-only-file ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- No column type is hardcoded; every type comes from the values of the file examined.\n- `empty` is assigned only when there are no non-null values; it is never assigned to a column that has any non-null value.\n- Standard library only.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-Counts.md ===\n# FEATURE: Row, Null, and Distinct Counts\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261024 V1 |\n| Description | Report the rows, nulls, and distinct count of every column. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-BooleanTextTypes.md |\n| Provides    | stats rows, stats nulls, stats distinct |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nFor every column the profile reports three counts: `rows` (data records), `nulls` (null values), and\n`distinct` (different non-null values). They are computed from the trimmed values of the column.\n\n## Trigger\n\nComputed once per column when the profile is built.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. `rows` is the number of data records, excluding the header. It is the same for every column.\n2. `nulls` counts values that are empty or equal `NA`, `N/A`, or `NULL` ignoring case after trimming.\n3. `distinct` counts the different non-null values, compared as exact strings after trimming. Case\n   differs, so `Acme` and `acme` are two values. `Globex` and `  Globex  ` are one value.\n\n## Reads\n\n- Trimmed values of one column.\n\n## Writes\n\n- Three integer fields written as plain decimal integers.\n\n## Acceptance Notes\n\n- A header-only file gives `rows`, `nulls`, and `distinct` of zero for every column.\n- A null never contributes to `distinct`.\n- A quoted field containing a comma is one value.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC counts-rows-nulls-distinct ===\nIntent: rows, nulls, and distinct match counts derived from the values the criterion wrote.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef is_null(v):\n    t = v.strip()\n    return t == \"\" or t.upper() in {\"NA\", \"N/A\", \"NULL\"}\n\n\nvalues = [\"red\", \"blue\", \"red\", \"\", \"NA\", \"blue\", \"green\", \"n/a\", \"NULL\", \"red\"]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"c\"]] + [[str(i), v] for i, v in enumerate(values)]\nresult = profile(rows)\nheader = result[0]\nby_name = {r[0]: dict(zip(header, r)) for r in result[1:]}\nc = by_name[\"c\"]\nnon_null = [v.strip() for v in values if not is_null(v)]\nassert c[\"rows\"] == str(len(values)), c\nassert c[\"nulls\"] == str(len(values) - len(non_null)), c\nassert c[\"distinct\"] == str(len(set(non_null))), c\nassert by_name[\"id\"][\"rows\"] == c[\"rows\"], by_name\n=== END AC counts-rows-nulls-distinct ===\n\n=== AC counts-distinct-trims-and-is-case-sensitive ===\nIntent: Padding does not create a new distinct value, while a case difference does.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nvalues = [\"Globex\", \"  Globex  \", \"Globex \", \"globex\", \"Acme Corp \", \"Acme Corp\"]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"c\"]] + [[str(i), v] for i, v in enumerate(values)]\nresult = profile(rows)\nheader = result[0]\nc = {r[0]: dict(zip(header, r)) for r in result[1:]}[\"c\"]\nexpected = len({v.strip() for v in values})\nassert c[\"distinct\"] == str(expected), c\nassert c[\"nulls\"] == str(0), c\n=== END AC counts-distinct-trims-and-is-case-sensitive ===\n\n=== AC counts-quoted-comma-is-one-value ===\nIntent: A quoted field containing a comma is counted as a single value.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydict_placeholder import nothing  # noqa\n=== END AC counts-quoted-comma-is-one-value ===\n\n=== AC counts-header-only ===\nIntent: A file with only a header reports zero rows, nulls, and distinct for each column.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nnames = [\"a\", \"b\", \"c\"]\nresult = profile([names])\nheader = result[0]\nassert len(result) == 1 + len(names), result\nfor row in result[1:]:\n    rec = dict(zip(header, row))\n    for field in [\"rows\", \"nulls\", \"distinct\"]:\n        assert rec[field] == str(0), rec\n=== END AC counts-header-only ===\n\n=== AC counts-single-column-selection ===\nIntent: The counts reported for one column through --column equal those in the full profile.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef run(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nvalues = [\"x\", \"y\", \"\", \"x\", \"NA\"]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"c\"]] + [[str(i), v] for i, v in enumerate(values)]\nfull = run(rows)\none = run(rows, \"--column\", \"c\")\nheader = full[0]\nassert one[0] == header, (one[0], header)\nassert len(one) == 2, one\nfull_c = [r for r in full[1:] if r[0] == \"c\"][0]\nfor field in [\"rows\", \"nulls\", \"distinct\"]:\n    idx = header.index(field)\n    assert one[1][idx] == full_c[idx], field\n=== END AC counts-single-column-selection ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Counts are computed from the file examined; none is hardcoded.\n- Distinct is a comparison of exact trimmed strings, never case-folded or numerically normalized.\n- Counts are written as plain integers.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-DecimalFormat.md ===\n# FEATURE: Decimal Formatting\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261024 V1 |\n| Description | Format exact decimal statistics with two places, rounded once half away from zero. |\n| Depends On  | ARCHITECTURE.md |\n| Provides    | FormatDecimal |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nEvery `number` column `min`, `max`, and `sum`, and every `mean` and `median` of an integer or number\ncolumn, is written with exactly two decimal places. The value is held exactly as a `math/big` rational\nand rounded once at output, half away from zero. Integer `min`, `max`, and `sum` are written as plain\nintegers.\n\n## Trigger\n\nCalled whenever a profile field holds a decimal value.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Take the exact value as a `*big.Rat`.\n2. Multiply by 100, then round to an integer with ties going away from zero (for example `0.005`\n   becomes `0.01` and `-0.005` becomes `-0.01`).\n3. Write the integer part, a decimal point, and exactly two fraction digits. No thousands separator.\n4. Write a leading `-` only when the rounded result is non-zero and negative. A value that rounds to\n   zero is written `0.00` with no sign (decision Q-002).\n\n## Reads\n\n- An exact rational value.\n\n## Writes\n\n- A string of the form `-?[0-9]+\\.[0-9]{2}`.\n\n## Acceptance Notes\n\n- Rounding happens once, on the exact value, never on an already rounded intermediate and never through\n  `float64`.\n- `1012.50`, `-12.21`, and `0.00` are well formed outputs.\n- The mean of `0.01` and `0.02` is exactly `0.015` and is written `0.02`.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC decimal-single-value-rounding ===\nIntent: A one-value number column writes min, max, sum, mean, and median as the value rounded half away from zero to two places.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef two_places(d):\n    q = d.quantize(Decimal(\"0.01\"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)\n    if q == 0:\n        q = abs(q)\n    return format(q, \"f\")\n\n\ninputs = [\"0.005\", \"-0.005\", \"2.675\", \"-2.675\", \"1.005\", \"1012.5\", \"123456789.125\", \"0.001\", \"-0.001\", \"0.00\"]\nfor text in inputs:\n    result = profile([[\"id\", \"v\"], [\"1\", text]])\n    header = result[0]\n    rec = {r[0]: dict(zip(header, r)) for r in result[1:]}[\"v\"]\n    expected = two_places(Decimal(text))\n    assert rec[\"type\"] == \"number\", (text, rec)\n    for field in [\"min\", \"max\", \"sum\", \"mean\", \"median\"]:\n        assert rec[field] == expected, (text, field, rec)\n=== END AC decimal-single-value-rounding ===\n\n=== AC decimal-mean-is-exact ===\nIntent: The mean is computed exactly and rounded once, so a tie in the exact mean rounds away from zero.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP, getcontext\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ngetcontext().prec = 50\n\n\ndef two_places(d):\n    q = d.quantize(Decimal(\"0.01\"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)\n    if q == 0:\n        q = abs(q)\n    return format(q, \"f\")\n\n\nfor pair in [(\"0.01\", \"0.02\"), (\"-0.01\", \"-0.02\"), (\"1.10\", \"2.25\"), (\"0.10\", \"0.15\")]:\n    result = profile([[\"id\", \"v\"], [\"1\", pair[0]], [\"2\", pair[1]]])\n    header = result[0]\n    rec = {r[0]: dict(zip(header, r)) for r in result[1:]}[\"v\"]\n    values = [Decimal(p) for p in pair]\n    mean = sum(values) / len(values)\n    assert rec[\"mean\"] == two_places(mean), (pair, rec)\n    assert rec[\"median\"] == two_places(mean), (pair, rec)\n    assert rec[\"sum\"] == two_places(sum(values)), (pair, rec)\n=== END AC decimal-mean-is-exact ===\n\n=== AC decimal-no-negative-zero ===\nIntent: A negative value that rounds to zero is written without a minus sign.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nresult = profile([[\"id\", \"v\"], [\"1\", \"-0.001\"], [\"2\", \"-0.002\"]])\nheader = result[0]\nrec = {r[0]: dict(zip(header, r)) for r in result[1:]}[\"v\"]\nfor field in [\"min\", \"max\", \"sum\", \"mean\", \"median\"]:\n    assert not rec[field].startswith(\"-\"), (field, rec)\n    assert float(rec[field]) == 0.0, (field, rec)\n=== END AC decimal-no-negative-zero ===\n\n=== AC decimal-integer-columns-plain-and-mean-two-places ===\nIntent: Integer min, max, and sum are plain integers while integer mean and median use two decimal places.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nvalues = [1, 2, 10]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"v\"]] + [[str(i), str(v)] for i, v in enumerate(values)]\nresult = profile(rows)\nheader = result[0]\nrec = {r[0]: dict(zip(header, r)) for r in result[1:]}[\"v\"]\nassert rec[\"type\"] == \"integer\", rec\nassert rec[\"min\"] == str(min(values)), rec\nassert rec[\"max\"] == str(max(values)), rec\nassert rec[\"sum\"] == str(sum(values)), rec\nassert rec[\"mean\"] == format(sum(values) / len(values), \".2f\"), rec\nassert rec[\"median\"] == format(2, \".2f\"), rec\n=== END AC decimal-integer-columns-plain-and-mean-two-places ===\n\n=== AC decimal-no-thousands-separator ===\nIntent: Large decimal totals are written without a thousands separator and unquoted.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return out, list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nvalues = [\"1000000.50\", \"2000000.25\", \"3000000.75\"]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"v\"]] + [[str(i), v] for i, v in enumerate(values)]\nraw, result = profile(rows)\nheader = result[0]\nrec = {r[0]: dict(zip(header, r)) for r in result[1:]}[\"v\"]\ntotal = sum(Decimal(v) for v in values)\nassert rec[\"sum\"] == format(total, \".2f\"), rec\nassert \",\" not in rec[\"sum\"], rec\n=== END AC decimal-no-thousands-separator ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Never use `float64` to compute or round a statistic; use `math/big`.\n- Round exactly once, half away from zero, at the moment of writing.\n- No thousands separator and no locale-dependent formatting.\n- A result that rounds to zero carries no minus sign.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-MinMax.md ===\n# FEATURE: Minimum and Maximum\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261024 V1 |\n| Description | Report the min and max of every column according to the ordering rule of its type. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-Counts.md, FEATURE-DecimalFormat.md |\n| Provides    | stats min, stats max |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nEach column row carries a `min` and a `max` computed over its non-null values, using the ordering\nrule of the column's inferred type.\n\n## Trigger\n\nComputed once per column when the profile is built.\n\n## Sequence\n\n| Type | Rule |\n|---|---|\n| `integer` | Numerically smallest and largest, written as plain integers. |\n| `number` | Numerically smallest and largest, written with two decimals (FEATURE-DecimalFormat.md). |\n| `date` | Earliest and latest date, written as in the file. |\n| `boolean` | `min` is `false` if any value is false, else `true`; `max` is `true` if any value is true, else `false`. Written in lower case. |\n| `text` | Smallest and largest by byte value of the trimmed string. |\n| `empty` | Both fields empty. |\n\n## Reads\n\n- Trimmed non-null values of one column and its inferred type.\n\n## Writes\n\n- The `min` and `max` fields of the profile row.\n\n## Acceptance Notes\n\n- Integer ordering is numeric: `9` is less than `10`, and `-3` is less than both.\n- Text ordering is by bytes, so upper case letters sort before lower case letters, and `10` sorts before `9`.\n- Nulls never take part.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC minmax-integer-numeric-order ===\nIntent: Integer min and max are numeric, include negatives, and ignore nulls.\nRequires: executable=go; Case\n   differs, so `Acme` and `acme` are two values. `Globex` and `  Globex  ` are one value.\n\n## Reads\n\n- Trimmed values of one column.\n\n## Writes\n\n- Three integer fields written as plain decimal integers.\n\n## Acceptance Notes\n\n- A header-only file gives `rows`, `nulls`, and `distinct` of zero for every column.\n- A null never contributes to `distinct`.\n- A quoted field containing a comma is one value.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC counts-rows-nulls-distinct ===\nIntent: rows, nulls, and distinct match counts derived from the values the criterion wrote.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef is_null(v):\n    t = v.strip()\n    return t == \"\" or t.upper() in {\"NA\", \"N/A\", \"NULL\"}\n\n\nvalues = [\"red\", \"blue\", \"red\", \"\", \"NA\", \"blue\", \"green\", \"n/a\", \"NULL\", \"red\"]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"c\"]] + [[str(i), v] for i, v in enumerate(values)]\nresult = profile(rows)\nheader = result[0]\nby_name = {r[0]: dict(zip(header, r)) for r in result[1:]}\nc = by_name[\"c\"]\nnon_null = [v.strip() for v in values if not is_null(v)]\nassert c[\"rows\"] == str(len(values)), c\nassert c[\"nulls\"] == str(len(values) - len(non_null)), c\nassert c[\"distinct\"] == str(len(set(non_null))), c\nassert by_name[\"id\"][\"rows\"] == c[\"rows\"], by_name\n=== END AC counts-rows-nulls-distinct ===\n\n=== AC counts-distinct-trims-and-is-case-sensitive ===\nIntent: Padding does not create a new distinct value, while a case difference does.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef profile(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nnames = [\"a\", \"b\", \"c\"]\nresult = profile([names])\nheader = result[0]\nassert len(result) == 1 + len(names), result\nfor row in result[1:]:\n    rec = dict(zip(header, row))\n    for field in [\"rows\", \"nulls\", \"distinct\"]:\n        assert rec[field] == str(0), rec\n=== END AC counts-header-only ===\n\n=== AC counts-single-column-selection ===\nIntent: The counts reported for one column through --column equal those in the full profile.\nRequires: executable=go; scope=test\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom drydock_go import cli_runner\n\n\ndef run(rows, *extra):\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:\n        path = os.path.join(d, \"in.csv\")\n        with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n            csv.writer(f, lineterminator=\"\\n\").writerows(rows)\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*extra, path)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0, code\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\nvalues = [\"x\", \"y\", \"\", \"x\", \"NA\"]\nrows = [[\"id\", \"c\"]] + [[str(i), v] for i, v in enumerate(values)]\nfull = run(rows)\none = run(rows, \"--column\", \"c\")\nheader = full[0]\nassert one[0] == header, (one[0], header)\nassert len(one) == 2, one\nfull_c = [r for r in full[1:] if r[0] == \"c\"][0]\nfor field in [\"rows\", \"nulls\", \"distinct\"]:\n    idx = header.index(field)\n    assert one[1][idx] == full_c[idx], field\n=== END AC counts-single-column-selection ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Counts are computed from the file examined;
